description: This file contains script functions related to the upgrade process for MediaTek MT7623-based devices in the OpenWrt firmware, including full system upgrade, image validation, and configuration copying.

methods.name: legacy_mtk_mmc_full_upgrade
methods.description: Performs a legacy full system upgrade including partition management and device flashing for MediaTek MT7623 devices.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main upgrade handler that delegates to specific upgrade routines based on the board type.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Validates the image to be used for upgrade based on magic bytes and board compatibility.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies device-specific configuration data to the recovery partition depending on the board type.
